reviews_h2: What people are saying about the collision repair

reviews.author: Willow Carlton
reviews.text: Daniel did a wonderful job matching colors on my 2008 Impala. You can't even tell where he had to repaint. Got my car back and everyone is commenting on what a great job. The wheels on the car look brand new. Thank you Daniel and crew

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.text: Locals know Danny's auto shop is the best place to have body work done on their vehicle. This shop has an excellent reputation. One time my vehicle broke down right by Danny's (luckily) and I walked up to the shop and told the guys what happened. They helped me get my car off the road and allowed me to leave it on their lot until I could have it repaired. One of the gentlemen actually gave my daughter and I a ride home as well, which was about 12 miles away. Thanks!!

reviews.author: pork chop
reviews.text: I took my 07 Chevy Equinox to Danny's to get an estimate after striking a deer. It didn't take long to realize I was dealing with a man that had a wealth of knowledge and experience in this field. After going to three other body shops that day I knew where I was talking my vehicle to get fixed.This isn't the first time I have dealt with a body shop. In the past I was given an estimate, then after my vehicle was taken apart the price of the estimate got jacked up. Even though it was an insurance claim it still irritated me. At Danny's I was given an estimate and they stuck to it and that's what it cost me to repair my vehicle. We got the vehicle back two weeks ago. I have been out of town for work and just this past weekend got to see the finished repair. I won't have to look far the next time I need body work done. The car looked great. Truly professional work. Thanks again for getting me through this latest repair. I will certainly return in the future.

reviews.author: Amber Maready
reviews.text: I am absolutely in love with the job they did on my 2014 Mustang GT. The work was done in a timely manner and they went above and beyond with replacing windshield wipers and detailing the inside to perfection. I hit a Turkey and it shattered the glass to a fine powder inside my car, not a trace of that powder is left behind. Completely pleased with the whole experience.

reviews.author: Party Gras Entertainment
reviews.text: Danny's Auto has been a staple in this area for quite some time. I recently had my (Sentimental) 1992 full sized Chevy Silverado w/Camper Shell completely restored. Danny's did some driver side body work where a deer tried to hitch a ride as well a complete paint & clear coat. Daniel work closely with me to choose the perfect color even providing samples. As the work progressed they were happy to provide photos of the progress, and even accepted additional work I requested on de-rusting and painting my chassis while the bed was removed. Danny's went well above, and beyond in covering a lot of details. Even provided the pictures in advance I was completely blown away at the finished product. When I went to pick it up I didn't even realize it was my truck. I even remarked to the person with me, "Wow! That's a beautiful truck" not realizing it was mine. From all of the staff that had a hand in restoring my truck to even better than originally new, to Laura in the office keeping me updated along with pictures I want to extend my gratitude! Thank you. Chris

reviews.author: Travis Martin
reviews.text: Danny’s repaired significant damage to our 2012 Toyota Venza. The red paint is a challenge to match, but they matched it very well. It was a pleasure to do business with Danny’s. We hope we can avoid accidents and bumps, but if we need quality work done we’ll call them again. Thank you, Danny’s Auto -Travis and Carol Ann Martin

reviews.author: Henry Konczynski
reviews.text: Awesome body shop. Danny's does the work right the first time. Family owned and operated by great people that care. Danny the owner, still paints stripes by hand! A true artist.

reviews.author: Maddie k
reviews.text: I was shopping next door at the hardware store. I came out to put things in my car and shut my keys in the trunk, car was locked. Danny's came over in less than 20 minutes after calling. Had my car opened quick! Only asked for $5 I gave $20 and was able to be on my way and got to work on time.

reviews.author: Sandi Bardwell
reviews.text: They recently fixed my Yukon after an auto accident. We drove all the way from Leland and were not disappointed. Danny was amazing to work with and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Michaela Lee
reviews.text: They fixed my car good, however they never pick up the phone or call you for progress. The communication side of things is not great almost non-existing, but mechanics know what they are doing.

reviews.author: Leo Moulton
reviews.text: Visit was amazing. I am in no way affiliated with this company. Someone I know backed into my 03 duramax and would rather not have done the insurance claim, we did some estimates for driver fender and front bumper replacement. Dannys auto beat others by about $300 and said would take about three days to do. It ended uptaking seven days due to an aftermarket fender not fitting correctly, because of this I was not going to use them to paint late my grandfather's 86 Ford that I am restoring. This Chevy is beat up a little bit, lots of performance upgrades but a few paint chips. When I picked it up it was spotless, detailed inside and out, the work was perfect and the even replaced my bug deflector that I told them not to worry about because it was already broken. With all of this done the final price still came out lower than they had quoted. This place is a prime example of good old fashioned southern hospitality and quality workmanship.

reviews.author: Jessica Bowen
reviews.text: Really nice people. Helped me with my flat tire even though that's not what they do ( normally). They also work with your insurance when you need body work. Always did a great job for me.

reviews.author: Eric Randleman
reviews.text: They went above and beyond for me and the work was phenomenal. I highly recommend them for all paint and bodywork needs.

reviews.author: Constance Rowe
reviews.text: I had a serious problem with my windows, they refused to go up. Danny and his crew took my door panels apart, ran the windows up, replaced my door panels, and pointed out some other fixes that I needed. Thanks Danny!!!!! #Dannysautoshop #BurgawNC

reviews.author: Beth Plyler
reviews.text: Great place good people. They help my mom with her car. Pray for them and their loved ones for Great health, Wealth and love in Jesus name amen

reviews.author: Chris Mitchell
reviews.text: Danny’s Auto and the staff there is top notch! Danny’s auto will always be my go to place on auto repairs and painting my vehicles! So professional and fast
